title: Introduce hold-to-confirm affordance and elevation harmonization for button variants
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Over the past two releases we've accumulated multiple ad-hoc surface treatments for icon clusters, cancelable actions, and elevation tokens. Engineers have reported regressions when combining compact/icon-only buttons with deferred and cancelable actions; designers have observed inconsistent z-order/elevation for split-button and floating toolbars. Goal: define a small, testable pattern that (1) introduces an optional hold-to-confirm affordance for destructive or irreversible actions, (2) standardizes elevation token usage across primary/secondary/ghost/icon variants, and (3) documents the cancellation UX (tap-to-cancel, escape, soft-cancel affordance) with accessible announcements. We want a minimal API for product teams: an attribute/effect like data-hold-confirm with a configurable threshold, visual progress, and an escape affordance. This ticket covers design spec, token mapping, and handoff for a single implementation in the React component library behind a feature flag.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec that describes hold-to-confirm behavior: default threshold 650ms, progress radial overlay for icon buttons, linear progress for full-width buttons, and microcopy pattern for 'Hold to confirm' when applicable.
Elevation token mapping document: mapping table from old elevation variables to new token names across primary/secondary/ghost/icon/disabled states.
Accessibility notes: screen reader announcement at start of hold 'Holding to confirm', announcement on release 'Confirmed' or 'Cancelled', and keyboard equivalents (Space+Hold).
A prototype Figma file with annotated states (idle, holding 25/50/75/100%, confirmed, cancelled, aborted via escape) and asset slices for animation frames.

Engineering acceptance checklist: feature flag gated, unit tests for hold threshold edge cases, telemetry event for hold-start, hold-confirm, hold-cancel, and regression tests for z-index stacking in toolbars.
Rollout plan documented: internal canary -> opt-in product teams -> full rollout with migration notes for custom token overrides.
progress_updates: 2026-03-01 — Kickoff: scoped behavior and measurable goals. Decided to gate behind feature flag 'hold_confirm_v1'.
2026-03-03 — Explored three visual approaches: radial overlay (best for icon), linear bar (best for full-width), and subtle scale + opacity (fallback). Chosen radial+linear combo for clarity.
2026-03-05 — Token audit: found 7 inconsistent elevation variables used by button styles across components. Drafted token mapping and backwards compatibility shim.
2026-03-08 — Accessibility review with Priti: keyboard equivalence required (Space/Enter hold), SR announcements must be non-repetitive; updated spec to debounce announcements during hold.
2026-03-10 — Handed off annotated Figma to front-end; engineering estimated 3 points. Added telemetry events to acceptance criteria.
comments: Arjun Patel — 2026-03-02: 'Would like to see how this interacts with existing optimistic cancellation flows. If hold is enabled we should suppress optimistic UI until confirmation.'
Priti Kapoor — 2026-03-05: 'A11y note: Ensure JAWS/VoiceOver don't flood users with repeated progress updates. Propose single announcement at start and one on completion/cancel.'
Ethan Lopez (Engineering) — 2026-03-07: 'We instrumented a prototype. On older GPUs the radial animation causes jank; plan B is to provide a static progress mask and CSS transition fallback.'
Sana Ahmed (PM) — 2026-03-09: 'Products: need a property to opt out of microcopy and to set a custom threshold per action. Also flagging that analytics team wants event schema by Friday.'
decisions: Use 650ms as default hold threshold (based on hallway testing and external mobile patterns).
Radial overlay for icon-only and inline small controls; linear progress for full-width and elevated primary buttons.
Provide 'soft-cancel' affordance: releasing before threshold cancels; pressing Escape cancels; long-press + move > 16px cancels (gesture escape).
Standardize elevation token names: e.g., token.elevation.surface-0 .. token.elevation.surface-3 and map existing variables to these tokens with shim layer.
testing_plan: Unit tests for hold timer boundary (+/- 20ms), rapid tap sequences, and move-cancel gestures.
Visual regression snapshots for all button variants in idle/holding/confirmed/cancelled states across light/dark/high-contrast themes.
Performance benchmark for animation on iOS/Android simulators and low-end Chromium instance; fallback verified when animations are disabled.
A11y validation with VoiceOver and NVDA scripted checks, plus manual keyboard-only flows.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal beta for Platform team (1 week).
Phase 2: opt-in for product teams via component prop enableHoldConfirm.
Phase 3: full default rollout after 3 weeks if no regressions. Provide migration guide for custom tokens.
migration_notes: When migrating to new elevation tokens, add fallback mapping in theme provider to avoid visual jumps.
Document how third-party CSS overrides should reference token aliases rather than concrete values.
